subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw support Azure Foundry/OpenAI Realtime Talk as a first-class Gateway Relay route, and which Azure auth and endpoint contract should be accepted?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the provider contract because the remaining work controls credential exposure, Entra/API-key support, Azure endpoint shape, browser fallback behavior, and user-facing diagnostics.

options.title: Design Gateway Relay Azure support first
options.body: Keep the issue open and have the provider/Gateway owners define the Azure endpoint, auth, diagnostics, and proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Ship API-key-only relay first
options.body: Implement a narrower API-key Gateway Relay path now while explicitly deferring Entra and broader Azure setup UX.

options.title: Reject bundled Azure Realtime Talk
options.body: Close the issue as out of scope and direct Azure Realtime users to external plugins or standalone bridges.

recommendation.title: Design Gateway Relay Azure support first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and have the provider/Gateway owners define the Azure endpoint, auth, diagnostics, and proof requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged GA Realtime provider work and live smoke coverage came through this owner path, making it the best available routing signal for the product/security decision.
